summary: Canada's largest airline, based in Montreal.
checkin: Online and app check-in opens 24 hours before departure.
baggage: Economy Basic fares within Canada, to/from the US, Mexico, Central America and the Caribbean include only a personal item, no carry-on; bags checked at the gate cost more. Basic fares also include no free checked bag.
tips: Basic fare to Europe, Africa, the Middle East or South America (tickets after May 14, 2026): 1st bag CA/US$90, 2nd CA/US$120.
Aeroplan Elite status members get extra baggage benefits.
